10A.
Amendment to the Agreement with the City of Encinitas and Tyler Technologies, Inc. for the Purchase and Implementation of Utility Billing Software for the San Dieguito Water District. Contact Person: Administrative Services Manager Umbrasas
Board take the following actions:
1) Authorize the expenditure of District funds for the purpose of approving Amendment 7 to the Agreement between the City of Encinitas and Tyler Technologies, Inc.:
a) $129,100 for professional services, software licenses and hardware,
b) $12,670 for annual software maintenance fees;
2) Approve a 15% staff-authorized contingency in the amount of $19,365;
3) Adopt Resolution No. 2016-05 entitled "A Resolution of the Board of Directors of the San Dieguito Water District Amending the Fiscal Year 2015-16 Budget, " to approve:
a) An increase in the amount of $16,976 to Project CW12R, "Utility Billing System Replacement," bringing the total project appropriation to $166,976,
b) An increase in the amount of $1,754 to the District's FY 2015/16 Operating Budget to fund the hiring of a temporary, on-call Program Assistant to provide project support, bringing the total operating budget appropriation to $12,012,586; and
4) Approve a future increase to the District's FY 2016/17 Operating Budget in the amount of $5,700 to fund the hiring of a temporary, on-call Program Assistant to provide project support.

Notice to the Public:
To ensure that the City meets your needs when addressing the City Council, all presentation materials which require the use of visual equipment need to be submitted to the City's IT Division at least 24 hours in advance of the meeting (except for appeal hearings where materials must be submitted 7 days in advance). This includes photographs, Microsoft Office documents (PowerPoint, Word, Excel). No CD's, DVD's, or USB thumb/flash drives will be accepted at the meeting. All materials must be in PC format and digital presentation items must be emailed to it-service-desk@encinitasca.gov . Please label all materials with the corresponding agenda item number. Should technical assistance be necessary, it will be available to presenters from 5:30 p.m. to 5:50 p.m. on the day of the meeting. Presentation of video/digital/photographs are considered part of the maximum time limit provided to speakers.
